outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrographs (photoactivation time-lapse images) with no plotted data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows scatter/line plots of normalized intensity vs time, where each point plotted (green/red markers with error bars) represents an individual measured time point of the recovery curve, with fitted model curves overlaid. Since the underlying data points themselves are displayed as the scatter markers (not just a summary curve hiding raw points), and scatter/line plots are exempt from requiring further overlay of individual points, this passes the check.
